method: Production Next.js localhost:3100; Codex in-app browser; displayed PerformanceProbe results read through accessibility tree; 5 s warmup / 15 s measurement. No machine-readable window export was available in the read-only browser scope.
limits: Means/medians/p1 values are captured from completed UI benchmark summaries.
